en.title: Maximum Total Power of k Items
en.description:
Choose the elements at exactly k distinct indices of the power array so that their sum is maximized, and output the maximum sum. Duplicate values at different indices can each be chosen. The original site's first example gives 13, which conflicts with the "maximum sum" rule; the correct result is 19.

The input/output and examples are compiled by CSWork; numeric ranges marked as this site's are this site's judging conventions.
en.input: The first line contains n k (1≤k≤n≤100000); the second line contains n integer powers (1..10⁹).
en.output: Output the answer required by the problem.
en.explanation: Example 1: choose 10 and 9 for a sum of 19; the original site's 13 is not the maximum. Example 2: the two 5s come from different indices, so both can be chosen, for a sum of 10. Example 3: only the single 7 can be chosen.
hints: Sort in descending order and sum the first k items, using 64-bit integers.
